entries.name: unparsed-soft-fork-1-byte-body-roundtrip#0
entries.description: Size-flagged ErgoTree (header 0x0b = v3 + size bit) whose body is unknown opcode 0xfd (1-byte declared body (the minimal soft-fork tree)): the JVM wraps it as UnparsedErgoTree and re-serializes byte-IDENTICAL (preserves the declared-size body). Identity round-trip. An impl that substitutes a Const(true) placeholder + empty constants (the soft-fork forward-compat path) diverges -> different propositionBytes -> different boxId -> UTXO-digest/consensus fork.

entries.name: unparsed-soft-fork-3-byte-body-roundtrip#1
entries.description: Size-flagged ErgoTree (header 0x0b = v3 + size bit) whose body is unknown opcode 0xfd (3-byte declared body — the full declared region (fd 01 02) is preserved, not just the opcode): the JVM wraps it as UnparsedErgoTree and re-serializes byte-IDENTICAL (preserves the declared-size body). Identity round-trip. An impl that substitutes a Const(true) placeholder + empty constants (the soft-fork forward-compat path) diverges -> different propositionBytes -> different boxId -> UTXO-digest/consensus fork.
